name: 哔哩哔哩
description: 国内知名的视频弹幕网站客户端，追番、看视频、看直播。
intro: 哔哩哔哩客户端提供视频、番剧、直播和动态浏览，支持弹幕、倍速、投屏和离线缓存，是国内年轻人常用的视频平台。

en.name: Bilibili
en.description: Popular Chinese video platform client with danmaku, anime and live streaming.
en.intro: The Bilibili desktop client offers videos, anime, live streams and a dynamic feed with danmaku, playback speed, casting and offline caching.

name: 抖音
description: 短视频平台客户端，刷视频、看直播、创作内容。
intro: 抖音电脑版可以刷短视频、看直播、发布作品和管理创作内容，支持大屏观看和键盘操作，适合在电脑上休闲和创作。

en.name: Douyin
en.description: Short video platform client for watching, streaming and creating.
en.intro: Douyin for desktop lets you watch short videos and live streams, publish content and manage your creations on a larger screen.

name: 腾讯文档
description: 在线协作文档工具，支持文档、表格和幻灯片。
intro: 腾讯文档支持在线文档、表格、幻灯片和收集表，多人可以同时编辑，适合团队协作、课堂作业和日常办公。

en.name: Tencent Docs
en.description: Online collaborative documents, spreadsheets and slides.
en.intro: Tencent Docs offers online documents, spreadsheets, slides and forms with real-time multi-user editing, suitable for teamwork and daily office work.

name: XMind
description: 思维导图工具，用来整理思路和做知识梳理。
intro: XMind 是一款思维导图软件，支持多种导图结构、主题模板和导出格式，适合做会议记录、知识梳理和项目规划。

en.name: XMind
en.description: Mind mapping tool for organizing ideas and knowledge.
en.intro: XMind is a mind mapping app with multiple layouts, themes and export formats, useful for meeting notes, knowledge mapping and planning.

name: 喜马拉雅
description: 音频分享平台，听书、听播客、听相声。
intro: 喜马拉雅客户端提供有声书、播客、相声评书和课程等音频内容，支持下载离线收听和定时关闭，适合通勤和睡前听。

en.name: Ximalaya
en.description: Audio platform for audiobooks, podcasts and storytelling.
en.intro: Ximalaya offers audiobooks, podcasts, crosstalk and courses, with offline downloads and sleep timers for commuting or bedtime listening.

name: ToDesk
description: 国产远程控制软件，远程桌面和文件传输。
intro: ToDesk 是一款远程控制软件，支持远程桌面、文件传输、手机控电脑和多人协作，连接稳定，适合远程办公和帮家人处理电脑问题。

en.name: ToDesk
en.description: Chinese remote desktop and file transfer tool.
en.intro: ToDesk provides remote desktop, file transfer and phone-to-PC control with stable connections, suitable for remote work and remote support.

name: 酷狗音乐
description: 国内老牌音乐播放器，曲库丰富。
intro: 酷狗音乐提供海量歌曲、MV、电台和 K 歌功能，支持歌词、音效和本地音乐管理，是国内常用的音乐播放器之一。

en.name: Kugou Music
en.description: Long-running Chinese music player with a large catalog.
en.intro: Kugou Music offers a large song catalog, MVs, radio and karaoke features with lyrics, audio effects and local library management.

name: 酷我音乐
description: 音乐播放器，支持无损音质和本地音乐。
intro: 酷我音乐提供歌曲、电台、MV 和本地音乐播放，支持无损音质、歌词和音效调节，界面简洁。

en.name: Kuwo Music
en.description: Music player with lossless audio and local library support.
en.intro: Kuwo Music plays songs, radio and MVs plus local files, with lossless audio, lyrics and equalizer options in a clean interface.

name: 小红书
description: 生活方式社区，种草、攻略和分享。
intro: 小红书是一个生活方式社区，用户可以分享穿搭、美食、旅行、美妆等笔记和攻略，也能搜索真实体验和购买建议。

en.name: Xiaohongshu
en.description: Lifestyle community for recommendations and guides.
en.intro: Xiaohongshu is a lifestyle community where users share notes on fashion, food, travel and beauty, and search for real experiences and recommendations.

name: 知乎
description: 问答社区，提问、回答和看专业讨论。
intro: 知乎是一个问答社区，用户可以提问、回答、关注话题和专栏，获取各领域的经验和专业讨论。

en.name: Zhihu
en.description: Q&A community for questions, answers and expert discussion.
en.intro: Zhihu is a Q&A community where users ask and answer questions, follow topics and columns, and read expert discussions across fields.

name: 微博
description: 社交媒体平台，看热点、发动态、关注明星。
intro: 微博是一个社交媒体平台，可以浏览热搜、关注话题和明星、发布图文视频动态，是了解热点事件的常用渠道。

en.name: Weibo
en.description: Social media platform for trending topics and posts.
en.intro: Weibo is a social platform for trending topics, following celebrities and posting text, images and videos, and is a common way to follow breaking news.

name: 美团
description: 生活服务平台，点外卖、团购和订酒店。
intro: 美团提供外卖、团购、酒店预订、电影票和跑腿等服务，电脑端可以浏览商家、下单和管理订单。

en.name: Meituan
en.description: Local services platform for food delivery, deals and hotels.
en.intro: Meituan offers food delivery, group deals, hotel booking, movie tickets and errands, with desktop browsing and order management.

name: 淘宝
description: 综合电商平台，购物、比价和看直播。
intro: 淘宝是综合电商平台，提供商品搜索、比价、店铺关注和直播购物，电脑端适合大屏挑选商品和管理订单。

en.name: Taobao
en.description: Major Chinese e-commerce platform for shopping and live sales.
en.intro: Taobao is a major e-commerce platform with product search, price comparison, store following and live shopping, well suited to browsing on a larger screen.

name: 支付宝
description: 支付和生活服务工具，转账、缴费和出行。
intro: 支付宝提供扫码支付、转账、生活缴费、出行和政务服务，电脑端可用于登录网页服务和管理账户。

en.name: Alipay
en.description: Payment and lifestyle app for transfers, bills and travel.
en.intro: Alipay handles QR payments, transfers, utility bills, travel and government services, with a desktop client for web services and account management.

name: 向日葵远程控制
description: 国产远程控制软件，远程桌面和开机。
intro: 向日葵远程控制支持远程桌面、文件传输、远程开机和手机控电脑，适合远程办公、运维和帮家人处理电脑问题。

en.name: Sunlogin
en.description: Chinese remote control tool with remote desktop and wake-on-LAN.
en.intro: Sunlogin supports remote desktop, file transfer, remote power-on and phone-to-PC control, suitable for remote work, IT support and family help.

name: 火绒安全
description: 轻量的国产安全软件，拦截弹窗和查杀病毒。
intro: 火绒安全是一款轻量的安全软件，提供病毒查杀、弹窗拦截、系统加固和启动项管理，占用低、界面干净。

en.name: Huorong Security
en.description: Lightweight Chinese antivirus with pop-up blocking.
en.intro: Huorong Security is a lightweight antivirus with malware scanning, pop-up blocking, system hardening and startup management.

name: 360安全卫士
description: 综合安全软件，清理、查杀和系统修复。
intro: 360安全卫士提供木马查杀、垃圾清理、系统修复和开机优化等功能，适合需要一站式系统维护的用户。

en.name: 360 Total Security
en.description: All-in-one security suite with cleanup and system repair.
en.intro: 360 Total Security offers malware scanning, junk cleanup, system repair and startup optimization in one suite.

name: 腾讯电脑管家
description: 腾讯出品的系统安全与清理工具。
intro: 腾讯电脑管家提供病毒查杀、垃圾清理、软件管理和网络加速等功能，界面友好，适合日常系统维护。

en.name: Tencent PC Manager
en.description: Tencent security and cleanup suite.
en.intro: Tencent PC Manager provides antivirus, junk cleanup, software management and network acceleration in a friendly interface.

name: 百度输入法
description: 中文输入法，词库丰富，支持语音输入。
intro: 百度输入法支持拼音、五笔、语音和手写输入，词库丰富，提供皮肤和快捷输入功能，适合日常打字。

en.name: Baidu Input
en.description: Chinese input method with rich dictionary and voice input.
en.intro: Baidu Input supports Pinyin, Wubi, voice and handwriting input with a rich dictionary, skins and quick phrases.

name: 讯飞输入法
description: 语音输入见长的中文输入法。
intro: 讯飞输入法以语音识别见长，支持语音、拼音、手写和快捷短语输入，适合需要快速打字的用户。

en.name: iFlytek Input
en.description: Chinese input method known for accurate voice input.
en.intro: iFlytek Input is known for accurate speech recognition, alongside Pinyin, handwriting and quick phrase input.

name: 网易有道词典
description: 词典翻译工具，查词、翻译和学英语。
intro: 网易有道词典提供查词、整句翻译、划词翻译和口语练习，支持多语种，适合学习和阅读外文资料。

en.name: Youdao Dictionary
en.description: Dictionary and translation tool for learning English.
en.intro: Youdao Dictionary offers word lookup, sentence translation, selection translation and speaking practice across multiple languages.

name: 语雀
description: 知识库与文档协作工具，适合团队沉淀内容。
intro: 语雀是一个知识库和文档协作工具，支持文档、表格、画板和团队空间，适合写笔记、整理资料和团队知识沉淀。

en.name: Yuque
en.description: Knowledge base and document collaboration tool.
en.intro: Yuque is a knowledge base and document tool with docs, tables, whiteboards and team spaces, suited to notes and team knowledge.

name: 剪映
description: 视频剪辑工具，模板丰富，上手简单。
intro: 剪映是一款视频剪辑软件，提供剪辑、字幕、调色、特效和大量模板，支持一键成片，适合短视频创作和日常剪辑。

en.name: CapCut
en.description: Easy video editor with templates, captions and effects.
en.intro: CapCut is a video editor with cutting, captions, color grading, effects and many templates, suitable for short video creation.

name: 格式工厂
description: 老牌格式转换工具，音视频和图片互转。
intro: 格式工厂支持视频、音频、图片和文档的格式转换，还能剪辑、合并和压缩，界面直观，适合处理各种格式问题。

en.name: Format Factory
en.description: Long-running format converter for video, audio, images and documents.
en.intro: Format Factory converts video, audio, images and documents, and can trim, merge and compress files in a straightforward interface.

name: Watt Toolkit
description: Steam 工具箱，加速商店、社区和游戏下载。
intro: Watt Toolkit（原 Steam++）提供 Steam 商店、社区和游戏下载加速，以及脚本、账号管理和成就统计等工具，适合 Steam 玩家。

en.name: Watt Toolkit
en.description: Steam toolbox for store, community and download acceleration.
en.intro: Watt Toolkit (formerly Steam++) accelerates the Steam store, community and game downloads, and bundles scripts, account and achievement tools.

name: TapTap
description: 游戏社区与下载平台，发现好游戏。
intro: TapTap 是一个游戏社区和下载平台，可以浏览游戏评分、玩家评价和攻略，下载手游和 PC 游戏，发现新游戏。

en.name: TapTap
en.description: Game community and download platform for discovering games.
en.intro: TapTap is a game community and download platform where you can browse ratings, reviews and guides, and download mobile and PC games.
